description: Removes variants of a burst by their ids, and deletes their reports. Find the ids with listBurstVariants, which shows each variant's parameter or filter values, and confirm them with the user. An older report's variant file stays in Google Drive or OneDrive. The user must be able to edit every variant passed, or nothing is removed: the burst's owner and admins can edit them all, other members only their own. From an AI client, the removal only asks the user to confirm it in Rollstack: it answers `confirmation-required` and runs once they confirm.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

variantIds.description: The variants to remove, by their `id` in `listBurstVariants`, which shows each one's parameter or filter values. Each must be a variant of this burst. 1 to 500 ids.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The burst to act on, by its `id` from `listBursts`. You can also copy it from the burst's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/collections/`.

name: removeBurstVariants
title: Remove burst variants
